title: Five largest March claims (date and time semantics, ROWNUM)
businessPurpose: Claims leadership wants the five largest claims of March 2026 with the claim day, how many days after the policy started the claim came in, and the policy's six-month review date.

invariants.name: at most five rows, and all five when there are that many March claims
invariants.sql: SELECT LEAST(5, count(*)) FROM claims WHERE claim_date::date BETWEEN DATE '2026-03-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31'

candidates.why: Half-open day range, epoch-based day difference, ADD_MONTHS last-day rule, deterministic tie-break.
BETWEEN on a timestamp ends at 00:00 on March 31: claim 9002 is lost and 9010 appears. Executable, plausible, wrong.
Review dates for policy 103 (starts on Feb 28) come out as Aug 28 instead of Aug 31.
Day count returned as an interval, not as a number of days.
The ADD_MONTHS month-end rule is applied only to 2026-02-28. Right on the primary data, wrong for any other month-end start date.
